title: Questions of a processed book, version 1
description: Book.questions.json: every kept question with its answer, where it comes from, the passage that supports it and the checker's verdict; the questions left out and why; the sections; the excluded text. Readers must ignore members they do not know, so that members can be added without a new version.

generated.description: UTC time the file was written, ISO 8601.

instructions_version.description: Version of the drafting and checking instructions the questions were written under.

run_id.description: Identifies the run. A question id is stable within a run; a new run of the same book writes new questions under ids that may look the same.

chapter_href.description: The spine document, as the package (OPF) file names it.

chapter.description: The document's name: its table-of-contents label, else its title, else its first heading.

checkpoint.description: The section's checkpoint id; null when it never had questions.

natural_boundary.description: The checker's verdict on the section's break; null when it was not judged.

questions.description: The kept questions, in reading order.

id.description: For example c0007-p2: question 2 of checkpoint c0007. The same id names the question in the prepared EPUB's rsvp/checkpoints.json.

checkpoint.description: The checkpoint that asks the question. Null for a question from a highlight that is practised without being asked at a checkpoint.

section.description: The section the question belongs to. Null for a question from a highlight outside every section.

origin.description: Present on a question the reader made from a highlight in the app, whose id begins with hq. The book's own questions have no origin.

highlight.description: For a question from a highlight: the highlighted words.

passage.description: The text of the supporting paragraphs, in the order cited.

status.description: passed: every criterion of the independent check is true. unchecked: checking was switched off. unverified: the checker's result for this question could not be used.

criteria.description: supported_by_section, accepts_paraphrase, answerable_from_section, does_not_give_away_answer, stands_alone. Empty when not checked.

citations.description: The paragraphs the checker found the answer in.

left_out.description: Questions that are in none of the outputs.

problem.description: The checker's finding at the last check.

history.description: Earlier wordings and why each failed.

excluded.description: Text in no section: front, back or editorial matter.

paragraph.description: Document and block number, for example d03-p011: block 11 of the third spine document.
